summary:
Iteration 8 — Increment 5 · Phase 2 'Real Travel Routing' (feature flag `real_routing`, kept OFF). Frontend-only against the public preview at 390x844. ALL eight scenarios A–H PASS. Final GET /api/config/public = {experience_profiles:true, experience_builder:true, experience_output:true, venue_hours:true, real_routing:false}. No React Native red screens, zero pageerror events.

A) ADMIN FLAG UI — UI login via landing 'Log In' → auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-submit-button → /admin. All FIVE flag rows + switches present and queryable: admin-flag-{experience-profiles,experience-builder,experience-output,venue-hours,real-routing}[-row]. Screenshot confirms the first four switch tracks are orange (ON) and real-routing is grey (OFF). Tap admin-flag-real-routing-row → tap again → admin-save-button. GET /api/config/public afterwards = {profiles:true, builder:true, output:true, venue_hours:true, real_routing:false} ⇒ real_routing stayed OFF and the other four remained ON. (aria-checked attribute is not propagated by RN-Web Switch so the toggle state was verified end-to-end via the public config endpoint round-trip rather than DOM attributes — same methodology used in Iteration 7.)

B) ROUTED demo spark /spark/demo-routed-0000-0000-000000000001 as owner guest 'guest-routing-demo' (localStorage['datespark_guest_id']=JSON.stringify(...), the storage util JSON-encodes AsyncStorage values on web). itinerary-leg-0-source == 'Route via Google Maps' ✓, itinerary-leg-1-source == 'Route via Google Maps' ✓, leg text has NO '~' prefix (full text: '🚗 Drive 10 min · 3.1 mi' and '🚗 Drive 8 min · 2.1 mi') ✓, travel-total ends with '· routed' (full: '🚗18 min · 5.1 mi drive between stops · routed') ✓, estimate-disclaimer contains the exact phrase 'Travel times are route estimates from Google Maps for the chosen mode; traffic and schedules may vary.' and does NOT contain 'Straight-line estimate' ✓.

C) MIXED demo spark /spark/demo-mixed-0000-0000-000000000001 as the same owner. itinerary-leg-0-source == 'Route via Google Maps' ✓, itinerary-leg-1-source == 'Straight-line estimate — not a road, walking or transit route' ✓, leg-1 text uses '~' ('🚗 Drive ~4 min · 1.6 mi'), travel-total uses '~' and has NO '· routed' ('🚗~14 min · 4.7 mi drive between stops') ✓, estimate-disclaimer contains 'Some legs are Google Maps route estimates; the rest are straight-line estimates, not real routes.' ✓.

D) STRAIGHT-LINE real spark /spark/b50acd38-5411-4b6f-ae1f-25fb40f7d711 as owner 'guest-hours-demo-02' (backend legs have source=null, so isRouted() correctly returns false). Both itinerary-leg-*-source == 'Straight-line estimate — not a road, walking or transit route' ✓, estimate-disclaimer contains 'Travel is a straight-line estimate, not a road, walking or transit route.' ✓, Phase-1 hours badges still render: itinerary-step-1-hours-text == 'Closed at this time' ✓.

E) LEGACY spark /spark/b9c910be-cb10-4af9-a48d-f2e3e5616b46 as owner 'guest-a91990e00dd0' (travel leg from backend has source=null). itinerary-leg-0 renders with source label 'Straight-line estimate — not a road, walking or transit route' ✓ (missing source gracefully falls through isRouted()==false), cost-summary PRESENT ✓, no red screen ✓.

F) FLAG INDEPENDENCE — PUT experience_output:false (via /api/admin/config with admin bearer); reload demo-routed: NO itinerary-leg-* (0,1,2 all absent), NO travel-total, NO cost-total; Phase-1 hours badges ARE still present (step 0 'Open at this time', step 1 'Closed at this time', step 2 'Open at this time') and hours-summary row still rendered ✓. Restored experience_output:true. Then PUT venue_hours:false and reload demo-routed: legs + source labels still 'Route via Google Maps' ✓, NO itinerary-step-*-hours (all three absent) ✓, NO hours-summary row, cost-total + travel-total still present ✓. Restored venue_hours:true. real_routing stayed false throughout.

G) SURPRISE PRIVACY — Created surprise spark via POST /api/sparks/generate with X-Guest-ID 'guest-surprise-iter8-test' + X-Premium:1, body {partner, romantic, 50-100, 10mi, Austin, surprise:true, scheduled_at:'2099-01-01T01:00:00Z', transport:'drive'}. API returned 3 generated spark candidates; ALL 9 travel legs across the 3 sparks have source='straight_line' and routing_source='straight_line' ✓. GET /api/shared/4fc1bdb1-4ca9-4b12-8806-380a354c61df (no owner context): activities=[], travel_legs=[], routing_source=null ✓ (frontend has no way to leak). RECIPIENT UI view (localStorage guest 'guest-recipient-iter8-xyz'): spark-itinerary ABSENT, itinerary-leg-0 ABSENT, invite-banner + surprise-card PRESENT ✓. OWNER UI view (same creator guest): BEFORE reveal → itinerary-leg-0 ABSENT, surprise-card + reveal-next-button PRESENT; AFTER tapping reveal-next-button → itinerary-leg-0-source == 'Straight-line estimate — not a road, walking or transit route' ✓ (the straight-line label is correctly chosen because routing_source='straight_line' and the real_routing flag was OFF when the spark was built).

H) LEGACY COUPLE regression on /create (all 5 flags at expected state) — who-option-partner → who-continue-button → vibe-option-foodie → vibe-continue-button → budget-option-50-100 → budget-continue-button → distance-option-10 + location-input 'Austin, TX' + Set (text label, no stable testID — see note) → find-sparks-button → when-find-sparks-button → results-loading PRESENT ✓, no error-screen, no red screens. Tab bar tabs tab-home / tab-sparks / tab-profile all render ✓.

FINAL: GET /api/config/public = {experience_profiles:true, experience_builder:true, experience_output:true, venue_hours:true, real_routing:false} — matches the required final state exactly.
critical_code_review_comments: plan.ts isRouted/legSourceLabel/travelDisclaimer: strict `leg.source === 'google_routes'` check correctly treats missing (legacy) + 'straight_line' + any unknown value as non-routed, producing the straight-line label every time. The three disclaimer branches (all routed / all straight-line / mixed) match the spec verbatim and were asserted on three distinct sparks.

Timeline.tsx line 119: `{isRouted(leg) ? '' : '~'}` correctly suppresses the tilde prefix only when a leg is Google-routed, and the per-leg source label `legSourceLabel(leg)` is rendered with testID `itinerary-leg-${i}-source` — matches the spec perfectly.

CostSummary.tsx line 85-86: `legs.every(isRouted) ? '' : '~'` + `legs.every(isRouted) ? ' · routed' : ''` yields the correct 'all routed' badge only when every visible leg has source='google_routes'. Mixed spark correctly dropped '· routed'.

admin.tsx FLAGS array (lines 17-23): new real-routing entry has the explicit cautionary copy 'billable beyond the free tier — keep OFF until approved', which is appropriate given the user has not authorized paid Google Routes usage.
/api/shared/<id> continues to return activities=[], travel_legs=[], routing_source=null for surprise sparks before unlock — the frontend has no way to leak legs or source labels to a recipient.
No deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch usage detected in the Increment 5 surface.
File-size discipline holds: plan.ts 127 lines, Timeline.tsx 130, CostSummary.tsx 97, admin.tsx 201 — all well under the 700-line threshold.

success_rate.frontend: 8/8 scenarios PASS (A admin real-routing row + save round-trip, B routed demo labels+disclaimer, C mixed demo labels+disclaimer, D straight-line real spark + Phase-1 hours still rendering, E legacy spark null-source → straight-line label, F experience_output and venue_hours independence from real_routing, G surprise privacy API+shared+owner+recipient, H legacy couple quick regression)

seed_data_creation: Generated 1 surprise spark set (3 candidates, kept id 4fc1bdb1-4ca9-4b12-8806-380a354c61df, owner guest 'guest-surprise-iter8-test') via POST /api/sparks/generate for Phase G. Feature flags were toggled through 3 configurations during F (experience_output:false, then venue_hours:false, then restored). Final config: all four non-routing flags true, real_routing false — matches required end state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://vibe-finder-75.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin: admin@datespark.app / SparkAdmin2026!. FIVE feature flags now: experience_profiles, experience_builder, experience_output, venue_hours, real_routing. Admin edit path: click admin-flag-<id>-row Pressable (NOT the RN-Web Switch — synthetic clicks don't flip it) and verify end-state via GET /api/config/public (aria-checked is not emitted). On web, AsyncStorage uses window.localStorage directly and the storage util JSON-stringifies values, so to impersonate a guest: `localStorage['datespark_guest_id']=JSON.stringify('<guest-id>')` BEFORE navigating. Known demo sparks: demo-routed-0000-0000-000000000001 (both legs google_routes, owner guest-routing-demo), demo-mixed-0000-0000-000000000001 (leg 0 google_routes, leg 1 straight_line, same owner), b50acd38-5411-4b6f-ae1f-25fb40f7d711 (owner guest-hours-demo-02, legs source=null → straight-line label), b9c910be-cb10-4af9-a48d-f2e3e5616b46 (owner guest-a91990e00dd0, legacy, leg source=null). The /create 'Set' button for location input is rendered via get_by_text('Set', exact=True) — there's no stable testID on that element; also, after clicking Set the UI auto-advances via find-sparks-button rather than exposing a 'distance-continue-button' testID (none exists). Minor UX note, not a bug. real_routing MUST stay false — do not persist it ON via the UI Save button.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs. Real Travel Routing (Increment 5 Phase 2) ships to spec in a controlled OFF mode: the admin flag row is present and defaults to OFF; the frontend plan.ts correctly discriminates routed vs straight-line legs via `leg.source === 'google_routes'` and renders the exact per-leg source label and the three mutually-exclusive disclaimer branches (all routed / mixed / all straight-line); the Timeline suppresses '~' prefixes only for routed legs; the CostSummary 'routed' badge appears only when every visible leg is routed; legacy sparks with null leg.source gracefully render the straight-line label; experience_output and venue_hours continue to gate output and hours independently of real_routing; surprise privacy is backend-enforced on /api/shared and the owner-side reveal correctly surfaces the straight-line label. Final GET /api/config/public confirmed real_routing=false at end of run.
